from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A company's financial record containing minority shareholder comprehensive income for the reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    minority_shareholder_comprehensive_income: float | None = Field(description="Total comprehensive income attributable to minority shareholders for the period, in yuan")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this financial data")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report, e.g., '2024年第一季度财务报告'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
